Name: Em's Ostriches
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Seven options for the ostrich. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
Including the ostrich, baby ostrich and 3 Marnie's livestock shop icon options
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures

The different types are:
Ostrich Male (black)
Ostrich Female﻿﻿ (brown)
Emu (brown and blue)
Rhea (grey)
White Rhea (white)
Moa (large beak)
Cassowary (red wattle)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Ostriches CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When hatching an ostrich, the type gets randomised and can be any of the seven options
If you rather choose which type you get, you can download ﻿"Em's Ostriches CP Config" instead
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a [i]config.json[/i]

The default is the Ostrich Male. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Ostrich mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]OstrichMale[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

If you don't want to wait to get the ostrich egg, try out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22008]Buyable Dinosaurs and Ostriches[/url]
This allows you to get ostriches from Marnie, including config options
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]
